title: Piko Builds a Home
moral: With effort and help, you can learn new things.

scenes.summary: Piko the bird loves flying but is afraid to build a nest.
scenes.text:
Piko the Bird Who Was Afraid to Build

In a tall tree near a sparkling river, lived a little bird named Piko.

Piko loved to fly and sing.

He chirped happily every morning.

But there was one thing Piko did not like…

Building a nest.

scenes.summary: Piko avoids building a nest despite advice from Lina.
scenes.text:
“All birds build nests,” said Lina the Sparrow.

“You need one too.”

Piko shook his head.

“What if I do it wrong?” he said.

“What if it falls?”

So he kept flying around… without a home.
scenes.image_prompt: sparrow advising bird while he looks unsure near tree branches, cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Rain comes and Piko struggles without a nest.
scenes.text:
One evening, dark clouds gathered.

Rain began to fall.

Drip! Drop! Splash!

All the birds flew to their nests.

But Piko had nowhere to go.

“I’m cold!” he chirped.

Piko sat on a wet branch.

The wind blew.

The rain poured.

“I wish I had a nest,” he said sadly.
scenes.image_prompt: small bird sitting on wet branch in rain looking cold and sad, cartoon style

scenes.summary: Lina helps Piko and teaches him how to build a nest.
scenes.text:
Lina flew over.

“Come sit in my nest for now,” she said.

Piko climbed in.

It was warm and dry.

“Thank you,” he said.

The next morning, Lina said,

“I’ll help you build your own nest.”

Piko nodded.

“Let’s try.”

They gathered twigs…

Soft leaves…

And tiny threads…

Step by step, they built a nest.
scenes.image_prompt: two birds building nest with twigs and leaves together, warm friendly cartoon

scenes.summary: Piko successfully builds his own nest and feels proud.
scenes.text:
Soon, Piko had his very own nest.

It was strong and cozy.

“I did it!” he chirped happily.

Trying something new may feel scary.

But with effort and help, you can succeed.

The End

story:
Piko the Bird Who Was Afraid to Build

In a tall tree near a sparkling river, lived a little bird named Piko.

Piko loved to fly and sing.

He chirped happily every morning.

But there was one thing Piko did not like…

Building a nest.

“All birds build nests,” said Lina the Sparrow.

“You need one too.”

Piko shook his head.

“What if I do it wrong?” he said.

“What if it falls?”

So he kept flying around… without a home.

One evening, dark clouds gathered.

Rain began to fall.

Drip! Drop! Splash!

All the birds flew to their nests.

But Piko had nowhere to go.

“I’m cold!” he chirped.

Piko sat on a wet branch.

The wind blew.

The rain poured.

“I wish I had a nest,” he said sadly.

Lina flew over.

“Come sit in my nest for now,” she said.

Piko climbed in.

It was warm and dry.

“Thank you,” he said.

The next morning, Lina said,

“I’ll help you build your own nest.”

Piko nodded.

“Let’s try.”

They gathered twigs…

Soft leaves…

And tiny threads…

Step by step, they built a nest.

Soon, Piko had his very own nest.

It was strong and cozy.

“I did it!” he chirped happily.

Trying something new may feel scary.

But with effort and help, you can succeed.

The End
